records.trigger: Unattended candidate host execution can remain silent until the long total timeout because the shared runner has no first-output watchdog and candidate productionExecutor performs no positive readiness admission.
records.observedFailure: At baseline HEAD, defaultHostRunRunner owns only timeoutMs and clears no startup timer on first stdout/stderr; candidate-spec productionExecutor invokes runHostRun directly. A silent or interactive launcher therefore remains alive until the total deadline instead of returning startup_no_output_timeout.
